groups.activity: repeat the floor-21 boss after one weekly full clear
groups.meta: 12.5% per component; ~8 kills expected per specific part
conditions: Clear the tower once per week to unlock the floor-21 hellevator; after that, repeat Roathe with no weekly limit.
The drop pool is shared with the Vinquibus bayonet's parts — runs that 'give nothing' are usually Vinquibus duplicates, which cannot be broken down.
Descendia is a no-respawn mode: a squad wipe fails the floor.
bonuses: Maphica also drops from containers on every floor plus fixed floor rewards (Infernums 2, 4, 9, 11, 16, 18) — a complete Uriel set costs 150 Maphica with zero RNG if you'd rather buy it outright.
Watch for a loot-room week (a Plunder/treasure floor placed early) — one reported ~40 Maphica per one-minute Xaku run that week.

groups.activity: kill and loot with a nuke/loot frame through the order phase and boss
groups.meta: materials come from kills and containers, not from completing orders
conditions: Completing Perita orders does not give Uriel's materials — orders pay Tauron Strike resources instead. Materials come from kills and looted containers, so ignore the order count and kill/break everything.
Perita bosses time out at 30 minutes; if your build can't kill it, the run is wasted.
bonuses: Xaku (max range, Pull + Greedy Pull), Atlas, Khora (4 augment), Saryn, Nekros or Gauss turn this into a passive side effect of the Tauron Strike / Tektolyst artifact grind most players are already running.

Resourceful Retriever plus a resource booster and a resource drop-chance booster reportedly matter more than Steel Path — one solo run with no booster still logged 1,957/1,975 Agnovidisc, 1,054/880 Laudavi and 338/350 Servoris.
Steel Path is optional: better rewards and a resource multiplier, but nothing about Uriel requires it.

disclosures.title: boss pick
disclosures.body: Vanguard (six Commandeered Prime Warframes) is fastest for single-target damage but roughest for everyone else, especially on Steel Path — Ash Prime's one-shot finisher and Volt Prime's re-applied shield are the specific complaints. Hunhullus and Dactolyst are better tuned for most builds.

groups.meta: 12h each component, 3 days main, 25,000 cr + 1 Orokin Cell
